title: Appraisal Order Final Inspection Outlay Courtesy
content:
### Outlay courtesy — Appraisal Order final inspection charge

**Rule.** The outlay courtesy of the final inspection charge reads the appraisal charges standing on the order, that is every charge less every refund: standing charges of 1,500 dollars or more take off 60 dollars, standing charges of 1,000 to 1,499.99 dollars take off 30 dollars, and lower standing charges take off nothing. The outlay courtesy is taken off the final inspection charge, the result never going below zero.

| Appraisal charges standing on the Appraisal Order | Taken off |
|---|---|
| 1500.00 dollars or more | 60.00 dollars |
| 1000.00 to 1499.99 dollars | 30.00 dollars |
| Under 1000.00 dollars | Nothing |

**Standing charges.** Every charge entry on the order, on every line, is totalled, and every refund entry on the order is taken off that total.

**Hypothetical ledgers.**
- Appraisal fee 1150.00, rush fee 250.00, gross-living-area surcharge 250.00, no refunds: standing 1650.00, takes off 60.00.
- Appraisal fee 650.00, rush fee 150.00, gross-living-area surcharge 210.00, rush refund 75.00: standing 935.00, takes off nothing.
- Appraisal fee 895.00, rent schedule fee 0.00, gross-living-area surcharge 105.00: standing exactly 1000.00, takes off 30.00.
